_doc: CITED published benchmarks for L9 — NOT computed in this repo. Use verbatim with source. HNSW (Malkov & Yashunin); PQ (Jégou et al.); IVF/FAISS (Johnson et al.); TurboQuant frontier (Zandieh et al., arXiv:2504.19874 — data-oblivious/online, no codebook; ≈2.7× from the distortion lower bound; better recall with near-zero indexing time). The PQ-m4 recall is representative.

pq.source: Jégou, Douze & Schmid, IEEE TPAMI 2011 (Product Quantization for NN search)

ivfFaiss.source: Johnson, Douze & Jégou, 'Billion-scale similarity search with GPUs' (arXiv:1702.08734)

turboquant.mechanism: random rotation → Beta-concentrated coordinates → per-coordinate optimal scalar quantizer; two-stage MSE + 1-bit QJL residual → unbiased inner product
turboquant.claim: outperforms existing PQ techniques in recall while reducing indexing time to ~0
turboquant.source: Zandieh, Daliri, Hadian & Mirrokni, arXiv:2504.19874 (2025, Google Research)
